# Getting Support

Need help with OwnPay? You are in the right place. This page points you to the best resource for your question so you get a good answer fast.

> 💡 **Please do not use the GitHub issue tracker for general usage or support questions.** Issues are reserved for confirmed bugs and feature requests. Support questions there will be redirected to Discussions.

---

## 📚 Official Documentation & Guides

Most questions are already answered in the documentation:

| Resource | Best for |
| :--- | :--- |
| 🌐 **[ownpay.org](https://ownpay.org)** | Product overview, downloads, features |
| 📖 **[docs.ownpay.org](https://docs.ownpay.org)** | Complete API reference & webhook specifications |
| 🎓 **[ownpay.org/docs](https://ownpay.org/docs)** | Step-by-step guides, deployment & gateway integration tutorials |
| 🧩 **[plugin.ownpay.org](https://plugin.ownpay.org)** | Modular gateways & add-ons directory |
| 📰 **[blog.ownpay.org](https://blog.ownpay.org)** | Release notes, changelog & platform announcements |

In this repository: **[docs/LOCAL_SETUP.md](../docs/LOCAL_SETUP.md)** · **[docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)** · **[docs/TRANSLATIONS.md](../docs/TRANSLATIONS.md)**

---

## 💬 Community Support Channels

For setup help, configuration questions, and general discussion:

- **GitHub Discussions:** [github.com/own-pay/OwnPay/discussions](https://github.com/own-pay/OwnPay/discussions) (searchable and community-driven)
- **Facebook Community Group:** [facebook.com/groups/ownpay.org](https://www.facebook.com/groups/ownpay.org) (connect with other operators)
- **Facebook Page:** [facebook.com/ownpay.org](https://www.facebook.com/ownpay.org) (announcements & updates)

> When asking for help, please specify your OwnPay version, PHP version, web server, and relevant error logs from `storage/logs/`.

---

## 🐛 Found a Bug or Need a Gateway?

- **Report a Bug:** [Open Bug Report](https://github.com/own-pay/OwnPay/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
- **Request a Feature:** [Open Feature Request](https://github.com/own-pay/OwnPay/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)
- **Request a Payment Gateway:** [Open Gateway Request](https://github.com/own-pay/OwnPay/issues/new?template=gateway_request.yml)
- **Improve Documentation:** [Open Docs Request](https://github.com/own-pay/OwnPay/issues/new?template=docs_improvement.yml)

---

## 🔐 Security Vulnerabilities

**Never** report security vulnerabilities in public issues or discussions.
Report privately via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/own-pay/OwnPay/security/advisories/new) or email **[security@ownpay.org](mailto:security@ownpay.org)**. See **[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)**.

---

## ✉️ Direct Inquiries

For partnerships, enterprise questions, or sponsorships:

- **General Contact:** [ping@ownpay.org](mailto:ping@ownpay.org)
- **Donations & Sponsorship:** [ownpay.org/donate](https://ownpay.org/donate)
